members.name: CycleError
members.doc: Subclass of ValueError raised by TopologicalSorter.prepare if cycles exist in the working graph. If multiple cycles exist, only one undefined choice among them

members.name: GenericAlias
members.doc: Represent a PEP 585 generic type E.g. for t = list[int], t.__origin__ is list and t.__args__ is (int,).
